_doc: Setup standard for a new Smartlead inbox. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-inbox-intake-design.md. daily_rampup 0 = ramp off (Smartlead accepts 5-20). max_email_per_day = campaign emails only (Smartlead support 15 Oct). weekly_step / max_daily = ScaledMail volume rule (15 Oct): Google 15 +2/week max 20, Outlook 5 +1/week max 8; ScaledMail Outlook (25/domain) fixed at 5; SMTP held at 7 until ScaledMail answers.
